title: Microsoft Teams: user setting to stop presence switching to Do not disturb while screen sharing (GCC High, DoD)
summary: Hold: the blanket statement that Learn does not describe the setting or its client location is too broad; a Microsoft Q&A moderator describes a screen-sharing Do not disturb setting, although not specifically for government clouds. The claims of no new data access or automated actions also lack supporting text, and licensing should acknowledge the published Teams requirement.
